solution:
The shaded part represents is the number of teachers who are writers, but NOT dancers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/57c5449c5c264bff409eabd0f21d6e0c947c809bb0a5e400c07ee32b440a310b.png]
